# hetznerrobot_ip (Resource)

A single IPv4 address of a server, adopted to manage its traffic warnings. IPs cannot be created here (order one with `hetznerrobot_server_addon_order`). Destroying the resource only forgets the IP; cancel it with `hetznerrobot_ip_cancellation`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopts an IP to manage its traffic warnings; destroying it only forgets it.
resource "hetznerrobot_ip" "main" {
  ip               = "123.123.123.123"
  traffic_warnings = true
  traffic_hourly   = 500  # MB
  traffic_daily    = 5000 # MB
  traffic_monthly  = 50   # GB
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The IP address.

### Optional

- `traffic_daily` (Number) Daily traffic limit in MB that triggers a warning.
- `traffic_hourly` (Number) Hourly traffic limit in MB that triggers a warning.
- `traffic_monthly` (Number) Monthly traffic limit in GB that triggers a warning.
- `traffic_warnings` (Boolean) Whether Robot sends traffic warnings.

### Read-Only

- `broadcast` (String) Broadcast address.
- `gateway` (String) Gateway.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the IP is locked.
- `mask` (Number) Prefix length of the network the IP sits in.
- `separate_mac` (String) Separate MAC address, if one is set (see `hetznerrobot_ip_mac`).
- `server_ip` (String) Main IP address of the server the IP belongs to.
- `server_number` (Number) Server the IP belongs to.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import hetznerrobot_ip.main 123.123.123.123
```
